events.label: Cornell fraternity alleged assault in October 2024

slots.name: date of assault
slots.sentence: The woman, identified in court papers only as Jane Doe, sued Cornell and seven former students last month, alleging she was given ketamine and repeatedly assaulted at a fraternity house in October 2024.

slots.name: date of police report
slots.sentence: She went to campus police three weeks after the encounter and gave a detailed account of what happened

slots.name: date of hearing
slots.sentence: “You look like an operating human being,” she told school investigators at a hearing in May of 2025. “You don’t look dead or asleep necessarily. So, lights are on, but nobody’s home. Your brain is not functioning at its proper level.”

slots.name: snapchat message time
slots.sentence: some drawn by a message one of the fraternity brothers sent to a Snapchat group at 1:42 a.m. using a vulgar term to advertise that a woman’s body was freely available.
